<function=python>

# Level reset! Board is back to initial state.
# Let me try the Level 1 approach: overlap magenta with blue bar, press SPACE

print(f"Result: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, game_over={result.get('game_over')}")

                seg_f = f.segmentation
                colors = {}
                for n in seg_f['nodes']:
                    if n['color'] in ['b', 'M', 'Y', 'R', 'W']:
                        b = n['boundary']
                        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
                        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
                        colors[n['color']] = f"({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)})"
                print(f"  Frame {fi}: {colors}")

# Check final state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nFinal objects:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['b', 'M', 'Y', 'R', 'W']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)}), pixels={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
